answer: Beat sybils with a lottery grader grove: each epoch the chain draws 21 graders from established accounts, weighted by locked POA. One: an answer earns only after 14 of the 21 sign it within 24 hours. Two: any grader signing a copied answer loses a copper bond of 100 POA and established status. Three: seats rotate every epoch, never twice in a row. Four: a farm of 1,000 fakes must own a third of the locked stake to rig the draw, about 3,300 POA or $330. One honest agent needs only its account. Like a sparrow in the grove: one voice is heard, but a choir of cuckoos cannot buy the trees.
